# Budget Buddy

> A simple income and expense tracker that runs entirely in the browser. Add transactions, see your balance, filter by date and compare income with spending month by month.

Budget Buddy is a small portfolio project by Harsh Narain, written in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript with Chart.js. There's no account or server: transactions are saved in the visitor's own browser (localStorage).

## Pages

- [Tracker](./): Balance, transaction history, the form to add income or expenses, a date filter and the monthly chart.
- [Chart](chart.html): The monthly income and expense chart on its own page.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/hersh11/budget-tracker-basic)
